request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a candy submarine: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped capsule, rounded at both ends, of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping along its top and three round pale mint candy portholes along its side; on top one small tower with a candy-cane periscope. Nothing red. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
